corrected_fields.summary: Reliability Incorporated (RLBY), an OTC-traded micro-cap company, filed an 8-K disclosing the completion of a share transfer pursuant to a settlement agreement with Vivos Holdings. Approximately 253.3 million shares were returned to the company, reducing outstanding shares to 46.7 million as of April 2, 2026. The company also amended its bylaws and plans to call a shareholder meeting later in 2026.
